_why: One case table, evaluated by BOTH implementations of the stock-in receipt gate: cloudflare/src/lib/stockReceiptGate.ts (the enforcement) and frontend/src/utils/stockReceiptFields.ts (the pre-submit check). cloudflare/scripts/test-stock-receipt-gate-pure.cjs and frontend/tests/stockReceiptFields.test.ts each run every case through their own side and assert the SAME code. A frontend that lets something through the backend refuses -- or refuses something the backend accepts -- fails here before a user ever meets the 400.

cases.name: a remove is not a receipt and needs nothing
a set that lowers stock is not a receipt
a receipt with supplier and a real cost passes
supplier missing
supplier is whitespace only
supplier absent entirely
cost left blank is rejected, never defaulted
cost absent entirely is rejected
cost null is rejected
an unreadable cost is rejected, not coerced to zero
a negative cost is refused rather than clamped
zero cost without the free-goods flag is refused
zero cost typed as a string is still refused
zero cost with the free-goods flag passes
the free-goods flag does not excuse a missing supplier
the free-goods flag does not excuse a blank cost
a top-up into an already-attributed lot inherits that lot's supplier
an UNattributed lot excuses nothing -- the blank is exactly what the choice fills
the lot's supplier does not excuse this receipt's own cost
a surface that cannot see the lot's attribution defers the supplier half
deferring the supplier does not defer this receipt's own cost
deferring the supplier does not make a zero cost free
a correction restores a prior state and carries no receipt facts
an unknown attribution string is treated as a receipt, never as an exemption
attribution receipt is the explicit default
